description: The Power Reactor Information System is the IAEA's database of nuclear power reactors in the world. The IAEA catalogue entry describes it as a data source with specification and performance history data for operating reactors, reactors under construction and those being decommissioned. Specification data include location, operator, owner, suppliers, milestone dates and technical design characteristics. Performance data include energy production and energy loss data, and outage and operational event information. The catalogue rates the quality as authoritative, confirmed with national contact points, and the completeness as all power reactors in the world, updated continually. Public web pages give country and reactor summaries; registered users get on-line access through web applications for data collection and indicator reporting, including PRIS Statistics. No open data licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the public site renders in the browser and detailed outage records need registration. Simulation uses are reactor fleet inventories for energy system models, outage and energy loss history for reliability studies, and exposure analysis of plants. Related records: data-ciesin-population-near-nuclear-power-plants uses reactor locations.
